shortDefinition: An open standard for connecting AI models to external data sources and tools in a consistent, secure way.
fullDefinition: Model Context Protocol is an open standard that defines how AI models discover, understand, and use external tools and data. It provides a universal interface layer so that tools built once can work with any MCP-compatible model. MCP handles tool discovery, parameter validation, authentication, and error handling, reducing the integration burden for both model providers and tool developers. The protocol is designed to be model-agnostic, enabling a single tool to work with Claude, GPT, and other models without modification. MCP represents an important step toward portable, interoperable AI tooling.
examples: An MCP server that connects a model to a company's internal database
A universal MCP file manager tool that works with any MCP client
MCP enabling a model to read local files, search the web, and run code
